output.text: {"notes":["The requested readout is at absolute time t=1.0 s for the load, with position and other named channels expressed in the world frame.","World coordinates are right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; position is in meters, swing angle in radians, and angular velocity in radians per second.","A scheduled support intervention runs on [0.55, 0.75) s: +0.27170824546716504 m/s² for 0.1 s, then the opposite acceleration for 0.1 s, after which the support is stationary.","boundary_crossed is defined by whether the load center of mass crosses x=0.1 m with 0.005 m hysteresis after the observation cutoff."]}
